newContractPolicy.stateWriterRule: A world-State contract names exactly one writerOwnerId and at least one writer source. A no-State contract uses writerOwnerId=none and no writer source.
newContractPolicy.approvalRule: Registration is necessary but never sufficient approval. The owning PRD, living runtime fields, Prompt budget, tests, blind simulation and independent acceptance still apply.
